exposure: Polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) exposure in early pregnancy
cohort: The study included 172 mother-child pairs with complete data in Tianjin City, China, where children were aged 6-12 months at the time of neurodevelopment assessment.
finding: Exposure to polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) during early pregnancy, whether individually or as a mixture, was negatively associated with child neurodevelopmental outcomes, specifically decreased personal social and language scores.
